Why executable environments and trustworthy rewards matter more than a headline score.","excerptZh":"解读Z.ai 8月14日公告：在基础模型不变的前提下扩展后训练，真正困难的环节是可执行环境、可靠奖励和长程任务评估。","tags":["GLM-5.3","Reinforcement Learning","Evaluation","Coding Agents"],"readTime":"6 min","sections":[{"heading":{"en":"The news: gains without a new base model","zh":"新闻焦点：基础模型不变，后训练继续扩展"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Z.ai announced GLM-5.3 on August 14, attributing its gains over GLM-5.2 to post-training rather than a new base model. The announcement emphasizes more environments, a broader task mix, and more training compute on the existing stack. At this article's August 19 cutoff, public weights were still a future release: the launch promised them roughly two weeks later.","zh":"Z.ai于8月14日发布GLM-5.3，明确表示相对GLM-5.2的提升来自后训练，而不是更换基础模型。公告强调在已有技术栈上增加环境、扩展任务分布并投入更多训练计算。按本文8月19日的专题时点，公开权重仍属于后续计划：公告表示约两周后发布。"},{"en":"One concrete vendor-reported comparison is Terminal-Bench 3.0, rising from 4.6 to 28.3. This is evidence about the stated evaluation setup, not a measurement of every coding job. Harness configuration and verification rules remain part of the result.","zh":"公告中的一个具体对比是Terminal-Bench 3.0从4.6提升至28.3。这是厂商在特定评测配置下报告的结果，不代表所有代码工作都取得同等提升。运行框架配置和验证规则依然是结果的一部分。"}],"sources":[1]},{"heading":{"en":"An environment is more than a prompt","zh":"技术拆解：训练环境不能只有一道提示词"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"The report describes generating runnable environments with multi-step dependencies and hidden state, using judges to check solvability and verifiers to produce rewards. It also describes checking verifiers against oracle, no-op, and unsolved states. These checks address a central RL failure mode: a reward can be easy to obtain without the intended work being done.","zh":"报告介绍了带有多步依赖和隐藏状态的可运行环境，并用评判流程检查任务是否可解，再由验证器产生奖励。它还提到对验证器检查参考解、空操作和未解决状态。这些步骤针对强化学习中的关键风险：模型可能拿到奖励，却没有完成原本希望它完成的工作。"},{"en":"My reading is that environment quality becomes a training asset. For a repository task, the reset must reproduce the same starting state, the dependency installation must work, and acceptance must depend on the resulting behavior. If a broken setup is labeled as model failure, the training signal rewards the wrong thing; if a superficial edit passes, it rewards a shortcut.","zh":"我的理解是，环境质量本身成为了训练资产。仓库任务需要可复现的初始状态、能够正常安装的依赖，以及依赖最终行为的验收条件。若环境坏了却被算成模型失败，训练信号就会偏离目标；若表面修改就能通过，奖励的则是捷径。"}],"sources":[1]},{"heading":{"en":"Separate improvement from evaluation drift","zh":"评测方法：区分模型提升与测试条件变化"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"I would keep a fixed evaluation suite outside the environment-generation loop. Freeze tool versions, sampling budgets, time limits, and network access. If an infrastructure bug requires a change, rerun the relevant baselines under the corrected setup. Comparing a new model on repaired tasks against an old model on broken tasks cannot identify the source of a gain.","zh":"我会在环境生成流程之外保留一套固定评测，冻结工具版本、采样预算、时间限制和网络访问条件。若基础设施故障迫使测试发生变化，就在修正后的配置下重跑相关基线。新模型使用修好的任务、旧模型使用坏任务，这样的对比无法区分提升来自哪里。"},{"en":"Also inspect failure categories: invalid actions, forgotten requirements, weak plans, and verifier mistakes need different remedies. Report accepted task completion alongside total attempts and cost. This is more informative than treating all failed episodes as one scalar penalty.","zh":"还应拆分失败类型：无效操作、遗忘要求、计划不合理和验证器误判，需要不同的改进手段。报告验收通过率时，同时给出总尝试次数和成本，比把所有失败轨迹压成一个惩罚值更有解释力。"}]},{"heading":{"en":"Capability checks must follow post-training","zh":"后训练之后，需要重新评估能力边界"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Z.ai also reports stronger cybersecurity capabilities as post-training scales. That observation makes the unchanged base model an insufficient reason to reuse an old risk assessment. For enterprise agents, my recommendation is to repeat authorization-boundary tests after each model update, keep tool permissions narrow, and measure whether the agent stops when evidence or access is missing. Better persistence should not become permission to invent success.","zh":"Z.ai还报告了后训练扩展过程中增强的网络安全能力。这说明“基础模型没变”不足以成为沿用旧能力评估的理由。对企业Agent，我建议每次模型更新后重新测试授权边界，保持工具权限与任务范围相符，并检查证据或访问权限不足时是否能正确停止。更强的持续执行能力，不应变成编造成功的理由。"}],"sources":[1]}],"sources":[{"title":"Z.ai — GLM-5.3 launch and evaluation methodology","date":"2026-08-14","url":"https://z.ai/blog/glm-5.3"}]}}],["$L7"],"$L8"]}],{},null,false,null]},null,false,"$@9"]},null,false,"$@9"]},null,false,null],"$La",false]],"m":"$undefined","G":["$b",["$Lc"]],"S":true,"h":null,"s":"$undefined","l":"$undefined","p":"$undefined","d":"$undefined","b":"Ijy8mNuywzMmfrpc5fVLn"}
